question.text: From which date has the buyback of shares through the stock exchange method been phased out under SEBI regulations?

explanation.text: The Logic: The source states that open-market buy-backs through stock exchanges are not allowed with effect from April 1, 2025. After that date, the remaining source-described routes are the tender-offer method and the book-building method, with the book-building offer required to remain open for a minimum of 2 trading days. The Trap: Candidates may guess at the cutoff date. April 1, 2025 is the specific regulatory cutoff for the stock-exchange route; tender-offer and book-building buy-backs continue and are not equivalent to a formal individual offer to every shareholder. Note: Pages 87 and 89 confirm the April 1, 2025 phase-out of stock-exchange buy-backs and the minimum 2 trading-day book-building offer.
